Extracts keywords, author, viewport, generator, theme-color, robots, lang, dir metadata

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.status_code.inspect
puts result.metadata.title.inspect
puts result.metadata.canonical_url.inspect
puts result.metadata.keywords.inspect
puts result.metadata.author.inspect
puts result.metadata.viewport.inspect
puts result.metadata.generator.inspect

puts result.metadata.robots.inspect
puts result.metadata.html_lang.inspect
puts result.metadata.html_dir.inspect
```
